profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer @ SNGULAR
profile.summary:
With over 10 years of experience in software engineering, I am a web development expert.

I am passionate about improving user experiences through innovative solutions that meet both user needs and business objectives.  As a Senior Software Engineer I work with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality software products using agile methodologies. I have a deep understanding of the software development life cycle and a strong proficiency in C#, .NET, ASP.NET, HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and Angular. I am also able to quickly learn new technologies and adapt to changing project requirements. I have successfully delivered projects for clients in various industries, such as social networking, e-commerce, and education. I enjoy collaborating with designers, product managers, and other stakeholders to ensure that the end product exceeds expectations. I am an excellent team player who values effective communication and teamwork. I am constantly seeking opportunities to expand my skill set and stay up-to-date with the latest industry trends.
